title: Manus Parent Company Completes a New Round of Over $500 Million in Funding, Tencent and Sequoia Continue to Increase Investment

content_html:
Manus, an AI star company, has recently completed a new round of financing exceeding $500 million, with its valuation significantly rising. The round was led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital, with existing shareholders such as Tencent and Sequoia China also continuing to invest, showing high recognition from the capital market for its technology roadmap and commercialization prospects.

Manus is known for its general AI Agent products, which are capable of independently completing complex tasks and are seen as an important exploration direction in the AI application layer. This round of financing will be mainly used for technological research and development, team expansion, and global layout.

Along with the financing news, the company also released a recruitment video, opening 17 positions worldwide, covering core roles such as product managers, algorithm engineers, and full-stack engineers, sending a clear signal of accelerated expansion.

Industry insiders analyze that the scale of Manus' financing falls into the top tier among AI startups, reflecting the continued enthusiasm of capital for the AI Agent field. With the funding secured and the team expanded, Manus is expected to further widen the gap with competitors in the general AI assistant field.
